summary: Episode covers multiple investment themes: failed public IT projects driving private healthcare growth, Just Eat Takeaway's strategic situation after Prosus bid, high-yield dividend plays in DNO with Kurdish oil, quality holding company Sammantaget for significant allocation, Flatex turnaround with 2027 targets, API Group's fire safety moat, XPEL's oversold valuation after growth slowdown, and Remitly's rapid growth at elevated valuation.
key_takeaways: Västra Götalandsregionens misslyckade IT-projekt (14M SEK/månad) kan driva privat vård tillväxt
Just Eat Takeaway kapitalallokering katastrofal: sålde iFood på botten, köpte Grubhub på toppen
DNO 12,5% utdelning med potential för högre när pipen öppnas i Kurdistan
Sammantaget 60% up this year - kvalitativt holdingbolag för betydande portföljandel
XPEL trading near 17x EBIT after 24% drop - potential oversold condition
API Group P30 med 5% FCF yield - bra för långsiktig pensionsplacering
